title: quadlet: resolve symlinks to find drop-ins in target unit directory
body:
Fixed rootless quadlet generation to include drop-in directories for symlinked rootful quadlets. The issue was that when rootful quadlet files in /etc/containers/systemd/ are symlinked to user directories (/etc/containers/systemd/users/$UID/), drop-in directories (.d files) were not discovered because /etc/containers/systemd/ is excluded from search paths for rootless users. The fix resolves symlinks to find the actual directory containing quadlet files and searches for drop-in directories there, ensuring drop-in overrides are properly applied.

Fixes: #29821
